'''Manuel García Velarde''' ({{IPA|es|maˈnwel ɣaɾˈθia βeˈlaɾðe|pron}}; born 14 September 1941) is a Spanish [[physicist]] and university professor,<ref name="cvucm">{{cite web|url=https://webs.ucm.es/info/fluidos/velarde/C_Vitae_MGV.pdf|title=Manuel García Velarde, CV|date=27 Dec 2017|publisher=[[Complutense University of Madrid]]|location=[[Madrid]]|accessdate=24 May 2019}}</ref><ref name="withoutbounds">{{cite book|title=Without bounds: a scientific canvas of nonlinearity and complex dynamics|url=https://archive.org/details/withoutboundssci00ryaz|url-access=limited|date=2013|publisher=[[Springer Publishing|Springer]]|isbn=9783642340703|editor1-last=Rubio|editor1-first=Ramón G.|pages=[https://archive.org/details/withoutboundssci00ryaz/page/n15 3]–54|editor2-last=Ryazantsev|editor2-first=Yuri S.|editor3-last=Starov|editor3-first=Victor M.|editor4-last=Guo-Xiang|editor4-first=Huang|editor5-last=Chetverikov|editor5-first=Alexander P.|editor6-last=Arena|editor6-first=Paolo|editor7-last=Nepomnyashchy|editor7-first=Alex A.|editor8-last=Ferrus|editor8-first=Alberto|editor9-last=Morozov|editor9-first=Eugene G.}}</ref> currently a member of the [[Academia Europaea]],<ref name="aeinfo">{{cite web|url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/User/Velarde_Manuel|title=Academy of Europe: Velarde Manuel|website=www.ae-info.org|publisher=[[Academia Europaea]]|accessdate=24 May 2019}}</ref> the Royal Academy of Doctors of Spain<ref name="radoctor">{{cite web|url=https://www.radoctores.es/academico.php?item=95|title=Manuel García Velarde - Real Academia de Doctores de España|website=www.radoctores.es|publisher=Real Academia de Doctores de España|language=es-es|accessdate=24 May 2019}}</ref> and the [[European Academy of Sciences]].<ref name="eurascprofile">{{cite web|url=https://www.eurasc.org/user/339/manuel-garcia-velarde|title=European Academy of Sciences - Manuel Garcia Velarde|website=www.eurasc.org|publisher=[[European Academy of Sciences]]|accessdate=24 May 2019}}</ref> Velarde has worked in American and European universities and [[Research institute|research organizations]], focusing on [[fluid dynamics]] and other [[Linearity|non-linear]] problems, including the [[Kinetic theory of gases|kinetic]] and [[thermodynamic]] theories, [[hydrodynamic]] and interfacial instabilities, [[Anharmonicity|anharmonic]] lattices and [[electronics]].<ref name="gscholar">{{cite web|url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=7jONFW8AAAAJ|title=MANUEL GARCIA VELARDE - Google Scholar Citations|website=scholar.google.com|publisher=[[Google Scholar]]|accessdate=29 May 2019}}</ref>

Because of his research achievements and international cooperation, he received the insignia of Officer of the [[National Order of Merit (France)|National Order of Merit]] of [[France]],<ref name="ordenmerito">{{cite web|url=https://es.ambafrance.org/Orden-Nacional-del-Merito-a-M|title=Condecoración de Manuel García Velarde|website=Ambassade de France en Espagne / Embajada de Francia en España|language=es|accessdate=24 May 2019}}</ref> belongs to the [[Ordre des Palmes Académiques]], and holds the [[Blaise Pascal Medal]]<ref name="bpascalmedal">{{cite web|url=https://www.eurasc.org/eurasc-awardees/blaise-pascal-medals|title=European Academy of Sciences - EURASC Awardees|website=www.eurasc.org|publisher=[[European Academy of Sciences]]|accessdate=24 May 2019}}</ref> and the Medal of the Royal Spanish Society of Physics.<ref name="medallarsef">{{cite web|url=https://rsef.es/area-de-miembros/premios-de-la-rsef/item/157-galardonados-con-la-medalla-de-la-rsef|title=Real Sociedad Española de Física - Galardonados con la Medalla de la RSEF|website=rsef.es|publisher=Real Sociedad Española de Física|language=es-es|accessdate=24 May 2019}}</ref>

== Life ==

Velarde was born in [[Almería]], [[Spain]], on 14 September 1941. In 1963 he graduated in [[physics]] at the [[Complutense University of Madrid]] and, thanks to a scholarship, started to work at the Junta de Energía Nuclear (JEN), precursor of the [[Centro de Investigaciones Energéticas, Medioambientales y Tecnológicas]] (CIEMAT).<ref name="cvucm" />

In 1965 he left the JEN, married María del Pilar Ibarz Gil and decided to work for a [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD]] degree. Influenced by [[Ilya Prigogine]], he ended up getting two PhD degrees, one in 1968 at the [[Complutense University of Madrid]] and another in 1970 at the [[Université Libre de Bruxelles]], which allowed him to work both in the Spanish academic world and abroad. From 1969 to 1971 he worked at the [[University of Texas at Austin]], where Prigogine led a research institute.<ref name="cvucm" /><ref name="withoutbounds" />

Back in Spain, in 1971 Velarde started to teach and research at the [[Autonomous University of Madrid]], where he created the Department of Fluid Physics. In 1979 he started to work at the [[National University of Distance Education]], where he created the Department of Physics, and in 1993 he returned to his ''alma mater'', the [[Complutense University of Madrid]], where he worked as a full professor and co-founded the Instituto Pluridisciplinar.<ref name="cvucm" />

From 1995 to 1997 he was vice-president and, from 1997 to 1999, president of the [[European Low Gravity Research Association]].<ref name="elgracommittee">{{cite web|url=http://www.elgra.org/?page_id=21|title=Committee – ELGRA – European Low Gravity Research Association|website=www.elgra.org|publisher=[[European Low Gravity Research Association]]|accessdate=1 June 2019|quote=Manuel G. Velarde (1997–1999)}}</ref>

Throughout his career, García Velarde has held visiting or invited positions at the universities of [[University of Paris-Sud|Paris-Sud]], [[Pierre and Marie Curie University|Pierre and Marie Curie]], [[University of London|London]], [[Aix-Marseille University|Aix-Marseille]], [[Université Grenoble Alpes|Grenoble]], [[Huazhong University of Science and Technology|Huazhong]], [[Sofia University|Sofia]], [[Stanford University|Stanford]], [[University of Cambridge|Cambridge]], [[University of California, Berkeley|UC Berkeley]], [[University of California, Santa Barbara|UC Santa Barbara]], [[University of California, Irvine|UC Irvine]], [[University of Paris-Est Marne-la-Vallée|Paris-Est Marne-la-Vallée]], [[Université Libre de Bruxelles|Libre de Bruxelles]], [[Norwegian University of Science and Technology|Norwegian of Science and Technology]] and [[East China Normal University|East China Normal]], apart from institutions such as [[Los Alamos National Laboratory]], the [[Saclay Nuclear Research Centre]] and the [[International Center for Mechanical Sciences]], of which he was [[Rector (academia)|rector]] from 2002 to 2004.<ref name="cismgovernance">{{cite web|url=https://www.cism.it/about/governance/|title=CISM • Governance|website=www.cism.it|publisher=International Center for Mechanical Sciences|accessdate=1 June 2019|quote=The Former Rectors: Giulio Maier (I), Friedrich Pfeiffer (D), Jean Salençon (F), Franz G. Rammerstorfer (A), Mahir Sayir (CH), Wilhelm Schneider (A), Manuel G. Velarde (E).}}</ref><ref name="cvucm" />

== Awards ==

* 1991: ''Academia'' award of the [[Spanish Royal Academy of Sciences]]<ref name="cienciasabc">{{cite news|url=https://hemeroteca.abc.es/nav/Navigate.exe/hemeroteca/madrid/abc/1991/10/16/069.html|title=La Real de Ciencias comienza hoy el nuevo curso académico|last1=C.|first1=S.|date=16 October 1991|work=hemeroteca.abc.es|accessdate=31 May 2019|publisher=[[ABC (newspaper)|ABC]]|location=[[Madrid]]|page=69|language=es-es|quote=La Real Academia de Ciencias Físicas, Exactas y Naturales, [...] En el transcurso de este acto, que tendrá por escenario la sede de la Corporación, se procederáa la entrega de los siguientes galardones: Premios Academia 1991 a los profesores Manuel García Velarde y David Nualart Rodón,}}</ref>
* 1994: Doctor ''honoris causa'' of [[Aix-Marseille University]]
* 1994: [[Ordre des Palmes Académiques]]
* 1996: Médaille Rammal of the [[Société Française de Physique]] and the Fondation de l'École Normale Supérieure<ref name="rammalin2p3">{{cite web|url=http://sfp.in2p3.fr/Prix/prix_anciens.html|title=SFP : Prix depuis la création jusque 1998|website=sfp.in2p3.fr|publisher=[[Société Française de Physique]]|accessdate=29 May 2019|quote=1996 VELARDE Manuel}}</ref>
* 2003: Premio [[DuPont]] de la Ciencia<ref name="dupontlavoz">{{cite news|url=https://www.lavozdegalicia.es/noticia/sociedad/2003/09/05/catedratico-garcia-velarde-ganador-premio-dupont/0003_1964770.htm|title=El catedrático García Velarde, ganador del Premio DuPont|date=5 September 2003|work=[[La Voz de Galicia]]|accessdate=29 May 2019|language=es}}</ref><!--
* 2003: Uva de Oro/Gold Grape (Casa de Almeria y de la Alpujarra en Madrid/ Almeria in Madrid)-->
* 2006: Medal of the Royal Spanish Society of Physics<ref name="medallarsef" />
* 2010: Doctor ''honoris causa'' of [[Saratov State University]]
* 2013: [[National Order of Merit (France)|National Order of Merit of France]]<ref name="ordenmerito" />
* 2015: [[Blaise Pascal Medal]] in Physics<ref name="bpascalmedal" />
* 2015: Doctor ''honoris causa'' of the [[University of Almería]]<ref name="eupress-ual">{{cite news |title=El físico almeriense Manuel García Velarde, nuevo doctor honoris causa de la UAL |url=https://www.europapress.es/andalucia/almeria-00350/noticia-fisico-almeriense-manuel-garcia-velarde-nuevo-doctor-honoris-causa-ual-20190927175731.html |accessdate=22 January 2020 |work=www.europapress.es |agency=Europa Press |date=27 September 2019}}</ref>
